
========================================================================
 THU MOI TRUONG SACH: dump Neo4j mot minh co du khong?
========================================================================
Stack dung de thu: MySQL TRANG + MinIO TRANG + Neo4j nap tu dump.
Tat ca dat ten tien to 'kag-clean-', KHONG dung vao stack that.

========================================================================
 1. Dung MySQL TRANG (khong co du lieu du an nao)
========================================================================
   khoi dong MySQL: rc=0
   cho MySQL san sang...
   MySQL san sang sau 3s
   Database co san: information_schema mysql openspg performance_schema
   Bang trong openspg: 34 (MySQL trang => 0)
   => Ket luan: do thi KHONG nam trong MySQL. MySQL chi giu metadata
      du an va schema ontology, dung lai duoc bang knext project restore.

========================================================================
 2. Dung MinIO TRANG
========================================================================
   khoi dong MinIO: rc=0
   noi dung /data: .minio.sys
   => MinIO trang chi co .minio.sys. Do thi khong dung MinIO.

========================================================================
 3. Nap dump vao Neo4j MOI
========================================================================
   khoi dong Neo4j: rc=0
   cho Neo4j san sang...
   Neo4j san sang sau 10s
   CREATE DATABASE legal (buoc BAT BUOC):
     
   Done: 3739 files, 2.409GiB processed in 46.160 seconds.

   Ket qua sau nap vao Neo4j MOI:
     node         : 7624
     canh         : 26029
     vector index : 36

========================================================================
 4. TRUY VAN THAT tren stack moi (khong can LLM, khong ton tien)
========================================================================

   [4a] Truy nguoc chunk -> van ban:
     "\"Nghị định 329/2026/NĐ-CP\""
     "\"Nghị định 329/2026/NĐ-CP\""
     "\"Nghị định 329/2026/NĐ-CP\""

   [4b] Vector index co thuc su tra ket qua (goi procedure that):
     "\"Điều 2\"", 0.9997539520263672
     "\"Điều 1\"", 0.9251465797424316
     "\"Điều 3\"", 0.9163608551025391

========================================================================
 5. KET LUAN
========================================================================

   Dump Neo4j mot minh: DU de co do thi.
   MySQL trang: dung duoc - chi can 'knext project restore' + 'knext schema commit'.
   MinIO trang: dung duoc - do thi khong dung MinIO.

   => Trinh tu day du cho may moi:
      1. docker compose up -d          (tao 4 container)
      2. knext project restore --host_addr http://127.0.0.1:8887 --proj_path .
      3. knext schema commit
      4. CREATE DATABASE legal + nap dump   (xem RESTORE-GRAPH.md)
      5. dien API key vao kag/kag_config.yaml
      BO QUA metadata_to_graph.py, injection.py, indexer.py

   Luu y: buoc 2-3 BAT BUOC chay lai tren may moi, khong the bo qua,
   vi dump khong chua database 'system' cua Neo4j lan metadata du an.

========================================================================
 6. DON DEP
========================================================================
   Da xoa toan bo container va volume tien to 'kag-clean-'.
   Do thi THAT sau khi thu: 7624 node (phai la 7624)
